description: Header file defining the AtomicHook template class for managing function hooks with atomic operations, used in the Abseil library.

classes.name: AtomicHook<ReturnType (*)(Args...)>
classes.description: A template class for managing atomic function hooks, dispatching to registered callbacks.

methods.name: AtomicHook()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to a no-op hook.

methods.name: AtomicHook(FnPtr default_fn)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hook with a default function.

methods.name: void Store(FnPtr fn)
methods.description: Stores a function pointer as the hook, with atomic memory ordering.

methods.name: FnPtr Load() const
methods.description: Returns the currently registered callback or nullptr if none.
